name: Employee Exit Checklist
description: An exit-day HR administration checklist for final pay, benefits, the exit interview, and returned assets.

items.text: Calculate the final paycheck including all hours worked
Add accrued, unused vacation or leave where applicable
items.note: Payout rules vary; follow local laws and confirm with payroll.

items.text: Include owed reimbursements, commissions, or bonuses
Apply any authorized and lawful deductions
Confirm the final pay date and delivery method
Provide pay stubs and year-end tax documents as required
Determine the last day of benefits coverage
Explain continuation or conversion options available
Process retirement or savings plan distributions or transfers
Cancel or transfer life and disability coverage as needed
Provide written details on how benefits end and next steps
items.note: Benefit rules differ by region; follow local laws.

items.text: Remove the employee from benefit provider portals
Schedule the interview for or before the last working day
Use a consistent set of questions about role and culture
Ask why the employee is leaving and what could improve
Create a safe, neutral space for honest feedback
Record themes and notable comments for later review
Thank the employee for their feedback and contributions
items.note: Aggregate feedback over time to spot patterns.

items.text: Retrieve the laptop, phone, and any issued devices
Collect badges, keys, fobs, and parking passes
Recover company credit cards and corporate accounts
Confirm return of documents, files, and confidential materials
Update the asset register to mark items as returned
Note any unreturned items and the recovery plan
Confirm and file the resignation or termination letter
Update the HR system to mark the employee inactive
Process any agreed severance or separation paperwork
Remind the employee of confidentiality and post-employment terms
Provide employment verification or reference details if offered
Archive the personnel file per your retention policy
items.note: Retention periods vary; follow local laws and HR guidance.

items.text: Verify all access has been or will be revoked on schedule
Confirm desk or workspace is cleared and personal items collected
Update internal directories and notify reception or security
Provide the employee with their final documents in writing
Share approved contact details for post-exit questions
Give a respectful send-off and wish them well
items.note: A positive exit supports your reputation and rehires.

faq.q: What is an employee exit checklist?
faq.a: It is the HR administration list completed around an employee's last day, covering final pay, benefits, the exit interview, and returned assets. It ensures the employment relationship closes correctly and on the record.

faq.q: What should the final paycheck include?
faq.a: It typically covers regular wages, accrued unused leave, and any owed expenses or bonuses, minus authorized deductions. Pay timing and rules vary by location, so follow local laws and confirm with payroll.

Exit interviews surface honest feedback about the role, management, and culture that current employees may hesitate to share. The insights help reduce future turnover and improve the employee experience.

faq.q: How is this different from an offboarding checklist?
faq.a: This exit checklist covers the final-day HR administration like pay, benefits, and asset returns. Offboarding is the wider process that also includes knowledge transfer and access revocation across the notice period.

faq.q: Can I print this employee exit checklist?
faq.a: Yes. Download the printable PDF, complete each item around the last working day, and file it in the employee record so every exit is handled consistently and documented.
